title: Luxuriant Low Syrian Wood Ear Mushrooms Stew
description: A savory and romantic Syrian dish featuring wood ear mushrooms, this stew is perfect for a special occasion, with a unique blend of flavors and textures, and is also FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Rinse the rehydrated wood ear mushrooms and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large copper mug over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the copper mug and saute until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the copper mug and saute for an additional minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wood ear mushrooms to the copper mug, stirring to combine with the spice mixture.
Pour in the water, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the mushrooms are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
